changelog:
Initial release of the data-pipeline-spec skill.

- Provides a complete template to specify ETL/ELT data pipelines, covering sources, transformations, destinations, SLAs, error handling, and data quality rules.
- Guides users to capture required pipeline details through clearly listed inputs.
- Supplies an output structure suitable for engineering handoff or architecture review, including sections for scheduling, monitoring, error handling, quality checks, and dependencies.
- Includes example tables, checklists, and text diagram patterns for clarity and completeness.
